description: QuantumGuard detection rules. Shared by the local scanner, the Git history auditor and the CI gate. Patterns are matched against code with comments (and Python docstrings) removed.

rules.title: RSA key generation (Python cryptography)
rules.quantum_threat: Shor's algorithm breaks RSA on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
rules.remediation: Plan migration of this key's use: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) or a hybrid KEM for key establishment, ML-DSA (FIPS 204) for signatures. Inventory where the generated key is used.

rules.title: RSA key generation (PyCryptodome)
rules.quantum_threat: Shor's algorithm breaks RSA on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
rules.remediation: Plan migration to ML-KEM (FIPS 203) / ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or hybrid schemes depending on how the key is used.

rules.title: RSA encryption (OAEP / PKCS#1 v1.5)
rules.quantum_threat: RSA-encrypted data captured today could be decrypted later (harvest-now-decrypt-later).
rules.remediation: Replace RSA key transport with ML-KEM (FIPS 203) or a hybrid KEM (e.g. X25519+ML-KEM) and an AEAD cipher.

rules.title: RSA via Java/Kotlin JCA
rules.quantum_threat: Shor's algorithm breaks RSA on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
rules.remediation: Move key establishment to ML-KEM / hybrid KEM via a provider that implements FIPS 203.

rules.title: RSA via Node.js crypto
rules.quantum_threat: Shor's algorithm breaks RSA on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
rules.remediation: Move key establishment to ML-KEM / hybrid KEM.

rules.title: RSA via Go crypto/rsa
rules.quantum_threat: Shor's algorithm breaks RSA on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
rules.remediation: For key establishment consider Go's crypto/mlkem (FIPS 203) or a hybrid KEM.

rules.title: RSA signatures
rules.quantum_threat: Signatures could be forged once RSA is breakable; past signatures are not retroactively decrypted.
rules.remediation: Plan migration to ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or hybrid signatures; prioritise long-lived signing keys.

rules.title: Elliptic-curve key generation (Python cryptography)
rules.quantum_threat: Shor's algorithm also breaks elliptic-curve discrete log.
rules.remediation: Identify whether this key is used for ECDH (migrate to ML-KEM/hybrid) or ECDSA (migrate to ML-DSA).

rules.title: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key agreement (Python)
rules.quantum_threat: Key agreements captured today could be broken later (harvest-now-decrypt-later).
rules.remediation: Adopt a hybrid KEM (classical + ML-KEM) for key establishment.

rules.title: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman (Go crypto/ecdh)
rules.quantum_threat: Key agreements captured today could be broken later (harvest-now-decrypt-later).
rules.remediation: Adopt a hybrid KEM (classical + ML-KEM, e.g. crypto/mlkem) for key establishment.

rules.title: Finite-field Diffie-Hellman
rules.quantum_threat: Discrete-log key agreement is broken by Shor's algorithm.
rules.remediation: Replace with ML-KEM or a hybrid KEM.

rules.title: ECDSA signatures
rules.quantum_threat: Signatures could be forged once ECC is breakable.
rules.remediation: Plan migration to ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or hybrid signatures.

rules.title: Ed25519 signatures
rules.quantum_threat: Signatures could be forged once ECC is breakable.
rules.remediation: Plan migration to ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or hybrid signatures.

rules.title: Short RSA modulus (classically weak too)
rules.quantum_threat: Keys of 1024 bits or less are below current classical guidance, independent of quantum risk.
rules.remediation: Remove immediately; never generate RSA keys of 1024 bits or less.

rules.title: Embedded classical private key (PEM header)
rules.quantum_threat: Embedded key material is a classical secret-exposure problem; the algorithm is also quantum-vulnerable.
rules.remediation: Remove the key from source control, rotate it, and purge it from history if required by policy.
